sections.title: Welcome and Why This Matters
content: Purpose of onboarding: establish safe, compliant day-one behavior.
Why this matters: patient safety, workforce accountability, and regulatory readiness.

sections.title: Section A - Organization
content: Mission, vision, and values guide care decisions.
Reporting lines define who to contact by issue type.
Scope of services defines what is authorized.
examples: HHA confirms task is in scope before proceeding.
LVN escalates schedule conflict through supervisor.
sections.completionPrompt: I understand reporting lines and scope of services.

sections.title: Section B - Ethics and Compliance Awareness
content: Code of conduct defines expected professional behavior.
Compliance program supports prevention, detection, and response.
Use hotline or supervisor reporting pathways.
Grievance and disciplinary processes are structured and documented.
examples: CNA reports documentation concern via approved channel.
RN reports potential policy deviation without retaliation fear.
sections.completionPrompt: I know how to report concerns and understand non-retaliation protections.

sections.title: Section C - Workforce Rules and Expectations
content: Timekeeping and attendance records must be accurate.
Visit verification must reflect real service delivery.
Policy acknowledgment and training completion are mandatory.
examples: HHA uses approved correction process for missed clock action.
RN completes acknowledgment before independent assignment.
sections.completionPrompt: I understand timekeeping and training completion expectations.

sections.title: Section D - IT and Security Basics
content: Agency systems are for authorized business use.
Follow policy for email, mobile device, and social media use.
Protect passwords and devices; report suspicious activity quickly.
examples: Staff reports suspicious password reset email to IT.
Clinician reports lost device immediately per policy.
sections.completionPrompt: I can identify basic security risks and reporting steps.

sections.title: Summary and Accountability
content: Know structure, scope, and reporting pathways.
Follow ethics, workforce standards, and security basics.
Completion is required for onboarding and access.

questions.prompt: Why are mission, vision, and values included in onboarding?
options: Shared standard for decisions and patient service behavior
questions.rationale: They align day-to-day decisions across all roles.

questions.prompt: A family asks an HHA to do a task outside documented scope. What should happen first?
options: Verify scope with supervisor or clinical lead
questions.rationale: Out-of-scope requests must be validated through proper escalation.

questions.prompt: You suspect a policy violation. What is the best action?
options: Report through supervisor or compliance hotline

questions.prompt: Which statement about non-retaliation is correct?
options: Good-faith reporting is protected from retaliation
questions.rationale: Protection applies to good-faith reporters across roles.

questions.prompt: You receive an urgent password reset email from an unknown sender. Best next step?
options: Report to IT or security and follow guidance
questions.rationale: Potential phishing attempts must be reported for containment.

questions.prompt: What is required before unrestricted system and scheduling access?
questions.rationale: Module 1 pass status is a mandatory onboarding gate.
